content: Thinking with supreme wisdom and compassion of beings as vast as space,Having fully perfected the two accumulations for three countless eons,You who became the glory of the three-thousandfold Sahā world,To the Supreme Guide, the Crown of the Śākyas, I prostrate.Having perfectly realized reality through great wisdom,And having attained the supreme state through great effort,Renowned as the second Teacher within this doctrine,To the feet of the Noble Supreme, Nāgārjuna, I prostrate.His foremost spiritual son, possessed of virtuous and glorious qualities,Who suppresses those of wrong speech and cares for the fortunate,Who shows the path of liberation to those desiring freedom,To the feet of Āryadeva, I prostrate.Possessing a mandala of wisdom with a thousand rays of excellent speech,Rising high in the sky of infinite objects of knowledge,The glory that illuminates the scriptures of the Sugatas like the sun,To the feet of the Noble Asaṅga, I prostrate.With the ninety-nine hundred thousand sections of the scriptural traditions,He adorned the throat of his intellect,Renowned in this world as a second Omniscient One,To the feet of the Supreme Scholar, Vasubandhu, I prostrate.Venerable through the power of supreme wisdom,Resplendent with the burden of marvelous qualities,You who utterly demolish the reed-groves of false speech,To the feet of Dignāga, I prostrate.By the logic of Dharma, you defeated non-Dharma,And the great sound of your renown resounds in the three worlds;Supreme sun of speech, who destroys the darkness of perverse talk,To the feet of Dharmakīrti, I prostrate.Dwelling in the midst of the ocean of ethical discipline,Majestic with the hood of the hundreds of thousands of Vinaya scriptures,Beautiful with the crown jewel of liberation and freedom,To the two supreme Lords of Nāgas, I prostrate.Having established the chariot-way for the teachings of the Muni,And showing the excellent path to all living beings,To the Six Ornaments and Two Supreme Ones who beautify the world,I prostrate always with a mind of devotion.Source of benefit and bliss, adorned with the ornaments of the three trainings,Who finalized the translation of the scriptures and treatises,And caused the Buddha’s teachings to flourish in the ten directions,To the learned and accomplished translators and scholars, I prostrate.
